title: LTZZZ: Existence Is Not Acceptance — Hash Matched, Brief Missed
description: 2026-10-20: task AET-00078 asked a worker to turn the day's article into a 9:16 short-video script. The file arrived, the hash matched, the memory gate passed — but it only asked for the source text back, with no title, storyboard, or script. The independent auditor scored it zero and rejected it; a small internal-credit slash (0.015, no on-chain payment) stayed on the ledger. Existence is not acceptance: a delivered file still has to meet the brief. Evidence-first AI governance by LTZZZ.
